_note: Canonical NON-SECRET tenant identity for the Oregon Wing (ORWG) Apps Script project — a single composite tenant holding cadets AND seniors. Values were read from the project's pre-migration config.js (2026-09-28). Copy into TENANT_* Script Properties (or run setupOrwgScriptProperties() in config-tenants/setup-orwg.gs) BEFORE the first clasp push: a push overwrites config.gs, and an unconfigured project fails loudly by design. Secrets (SA_IMPERSONATION_EMAIL, SA_PRIVATE_KEY, SA_PRIVATE_KEY_ID, CAPWATCH_AUTHORIZATION) are NOT stored here.
